title: Re-enable read-only reviewer git -C / --git-dir behind git-env hardening
outcome: Repository-retargeting git global options were dropped from the read-only reviewer checker (a tracked bare-repo fixture .git/config core.fsmonitor/diff.external would exec). To restore, have TermAl neutralize the exec sinks in the reviewer child git env (e.g. GIT_CONFIG_COUNT with diff.external=, core.fsmonitor=, core.pager=cat), since the checker cannot rewrite the verbatim command. GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 does not help (system config only).
